D4. EKS Pod Identity support. The MongoDB authentication spec's MONGODB-AWS credential order covers AWS_CONTAINER_CREDENTIALS_RELATIVE_URI (the ECS endpoint) and has no AWS_CONTAINER_CREDENTIALS_FULL_URI step, which is the variable EKS Pod Identity uses. The Node driver, when the optional aws-sdk/credential-providers dependency is installed, retrieves credentials in the priority order defined by the AWS SDK, and its documented order ends with the EC2 or ECS Instance Metadata Service. The C# driver documents AWS_CONTAINER_CREDENTIALS_FULL_URI for ECS container credentials. A Node driver ticket (NODE-7001) reported that the driver rejected the Pod Identity endpoint 169.254.170.23 as not a valid container metadata service hostname. No MongoDB page found explicitly states whether EKS Pod Identity is supported, so support appears to be driver-dependent and undocumented. Sources: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/mongodb/specifications/master/source/auth/auth.md ; https://www.mongodb.com/docs/drivers/node/current/security/authentication/aws-iam/
